newsitem.title: USA: Warren Bancorp names John Putney as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Warren Bancorp names John Putney as CEO.

text.p: Warren Bancorp Inc on Thursday said it named John Putney as its new chief executive officer, to succeed George Phillips, who will retire at the end of the year.
Putney has been with the company since September, 1988, and is currently the senior executive responsible for all corporate banking serives, the company said in a statement.
Putney is expected to be elected as chief executive officer as of Jan 1, 1998, Warren said.
Phillips will continue as a director and will serve as chairman of a newly-established strategic planning committee, the company said.
